title: Soft Sophistication - New Synthesis Series
bodyHtml:
Soft Sophistication

Synthesis blends bold lines and soft curves to create a sophisticated aesthetic, offering a cohesive design narrative that runs seamlessly across a versatile range of basins, toilets, and baths.

Proudly crafted in Italy by Olympia Ceramica, every piece of the Synthesis collection embodies exceptional quality and artistry.

Minimal, Versatile, Functional

The Synthesis basins are available in a variety of sizes, making them perfect for any space, whether used as a bold statement piece on a bench or vanity, or wall-mounted to save floor space.

With an added bonus of a built-in towel rail, these basins not only look incredible but also offer convenient functionality. Plus, the in-built shelf provides extra space for all your on-hand necessities.

Powerful & Efficient Rimless Toilets

The Synthesis Eco rimless toilet range offers versatility with back-to-wall suites, wall-faced pans, and wall-hung options, allowing you to find the perfect fit for your bathroom layout.

Enjoy a powerful yet water-efficient flush with our innovative 4-star rated rimless system. Synthesis toilets combine practicality and beauty in it’s minimalist form.

Luxurious Baths

Complete your bathroom's soft square aesthetic with our Verve or Decus Freestanding Baths, providing a stunning continuation of Synthesis' sleek design, helping you create a seamless and luxurious space from every angle.
